covarianceFrame.pointwiseProducts: C_raw(u)=(u_r*u_theta,u_r*u_z) and B_raw(u,v)=(u_r*v_theta+v_r*u_theta,u_r*v_z+v_r*u_z). Project the Cartesian physical vectors onto these actual bases first.
covarianceFrame.definition: The original C(u)=<<C_raw(u)>_theta>_Y and B(u,v)=<<B_raw(u,v)>_theta>_Y include both the angular and normalized auxiliary Haar averages (7.23). These are covariance operations. The pointwise products in the full physical NS residual are retained separately and are never replaced by an average.

n6Interface.covarianceMeaning: The certified7.30 identity is the angular/Haar average of the primary wave. The actual full physical curl differs by the retained curl remainder; its complete NS residual stays in this interface.

scopeOfThisCheck: Byte identity, namespace and boundary validation only; the old computations are not rerun or enlarged.
